title: 第2章 脱胎换骨
content_zh:
这是一家破旧的小店，没有名字，客源凄凉，平日里就靠卖点小酒小菜为生，老板是一个糟糕的老头子，陆凡一直叫他老吴，这个老家伙从来都是醉醺醺的模样。今天也不例外，陆凡已经走到了他的门口，他还抱着酒坛子呼呼大睡。

破旧的桌椅，带着一股腐烂的气息。灰尘遍地，隐约还能看到几只老鼠在墙角嬉戏。可陆凡喜欢这个地方，因为这里安静，没有嘲笑，没有讥讽。

陆凡敲了敲柜台，老吴这才睁开朦胧的睡眼。

抬眼看着陆凡，老吴首先伸出手，陆凡拿出铜板扔在柜台上。

老吴先将铜板收起，然后居然就把怀里的酒坛递给了陆凡，用略带浑浊的声音道：“还剩一半，便宜你了。你要喝不完就给我拿回来。”

老吴笑着拿出一个缺了口的碗，放到柜台上。

陆凡将酒坛与碗拿走，随便找了个张桌子坐下，倒满一碗酒，仰头就是一大口。

浓烈的酒从喉咙进入腹中，很快陆凡便感觉到自己的身体热了起来，仿佛有一股火焰在他的体内燃烧。

陆凡一声赞叹。他喜欢这家店的第二个原因就是因为这里的酒够劲，与别的地方都不一样。

老吴笑着道：“那是，也不看看是谁家的酒。陆凡，你又受打击了？”

陆凡苦笑一声道：“我哪天不受打击。”

老吴道：“别这么说。你不觉得你能活到现在已经是个奇迹了吗？我还记得你第一次走进我店的时候，瘦的跟只小猴子一样。几乎都快死了，你看看你现在，一切正常。”

陆凡笑了起来，老吴这话倒是说得没错。小时候医师给他诊断过，他绝对活不过十二岁，但现在他活到了十七，并且还好好的，确实是个奇迹了。

陆凡转头对老吴道：“那可能是你的酒好吧。”

老吴眼中闪过奇异的光，同样笑着道：“那是当然，我的酒当然是最好的。”

陆凡长叹一声道：“我的女人因为我是一个废物，抛弃了我。”

老吴眯起了眼睛，道：“那她以后一定会后悔的。”

陆凡轻笑了起来，道：“老吴，谢谢你安慰我。”

老吴笑着道：“相信我，这不是安慰。”

陆凡又灌了自己一碗酒，道：“可惜，我以后恐怕不能再来喝你的酒了。”

老吴脸上的笑容收敛，从柜台后面走了过来道：“怎么了？你要走了？”

陆凡点头道：“是的，我要走了。今年武道学院的测试，我又没过。我已经十七岁了，最多也就还有明年最后一次测试的机会，但家族绝不会让我丢人丢到底的。应该在今年年祭之后，他们就会把我外放，我也不知道会被放到哪里，但肯定是再也回不来了。”

老吴摇摇晃晃在陆凡的对面坐下，道：“这么惨？”

陆凡点头道：“对，就是这么惨。老吴，我走的时候一定多买你几坛酒，备着路上喝。”

老吴道：“没问题。我一定给你多备几坛。不过我倒觉得，你不用走，你不如明年再试试，也许考的上呢？”

陆凡笑了起来，只是笑容略显悲凉。

老吴道：“那你以后也不练武了？”

陆凡此时眼神忽的锐利起来，道：“武我一定会练，武道就是我的一切。哪怕我此生无法凝成罡劲，但我也以自己是一名练武者为荣。

老吴神色微微有了变化，仿佛是没有想到陆凡此时还能说出如此豪情万丈的话。

“昨夜冷风残月，今朝凄雨悲雪。苦海浪涛几时休，一醉解千愁。遥想十年武道，泪往杯中流。心有苍穹人先走，谁人知，谁人留。”

陆凡听着老吴的诗词，眼中带着凄然，举起酒坛开始豪饮。

老吴轻轻的吟着最后两句，站起身，走回柜台。

用手缓缓从柜台下面拿出一小坛酒。

“来，陆凡，喝我这一坛。这一坛酒，我存了二十年了，今天让我们一醉方休。”

开封，香气满屋。陆凡醉眼朦胧的看着老吴给他倒了一碗酒，笑着道：“这酒怎么是绿色的。”

老吴面色平静，丝毫没有了醉态，轻声道：“你喝多了。”

陆凡笑着道：“对，我是喝多了。让我来尝尝你这碗酒有何不同。”

仰头一碗酒入喉，陆凡只感觉从喉咙开始，仿佛一把火直入胸腹。陆凡的整张脸都变得通红。

老吴又给陆凡倒了一碗，道：“接着喝，这酒够劲吧。”

陆凡感觉自己都快说不出话来了，半晌，憋出两个字道：“够劲。”

说完，陆凡又喝了一碗，这一次感觉更加猛烈了。

陆凡似乎能听到自己的骨骼都在发出咔嚓声响，气血翻腾，眼前已经开始有些模糊了。

站起身，陆凡道：“老吴，看来我真的有些醉了，不行，我要先回去了。”

陆凡摇摇晃晃的往外走，老吴看着陆凡的背影道：“记得过几天再过来喝，这坛酒我给你留着。”

陆凡摆手道：“放心，我一定会来的。”

老吴笑着轻声道：“你当然会来的。”

老吴轻轻挥手，只见酒坛如鬼魂操纵一般轻轻飘起，然后落回了柜台之中。

老吴手指有规律的敲击着桌子，摇头晃脑的轻唱起来。

“八千里山河剑与酒，九万里苍穹梦与醒。三杯即可通大道，一斗方晓天地合。阴阳杯中趣，人生酒中情。不知明朝谁处去，何人笑我，我笑何人。。。。。。”

回家路上，北风呼啸，飘飞的雪如刀子般打在陆凡的脸上，他却浑然不觉。

身躯摇晃着走回到陆家，远远的他已经能看到大门。

但这时，脚下重心不稳，陆凡摔倒在了地上。

趴在地上，陆凡感觉浑身没有了气力，只剩身体内流转的热量。

意识渐渐有些模糊，陆凡趴在地上没有爬起来，大雪缓缓将他的身躯覆盖。

一道光芒从他的身上亮起，转眼消失无踪。他的身体发出低吟之声，全身毛孔张开，肉眼可见的，一股气流在他身边旋转。

如果有武道高手刚好在此，定会惊呼出声，因为陆凡现在的状况，实在太像了武道传说中的脱胎换骨。

content_en:
This is a shabby little shop with no name and a poor customer base. It usually makes a living by selling some wine and dishes. The boss is a terrible old man. Lu Fan always calls him Lao Wu. This old guy always looks drunk.Today was no exception. Lu Fan had already walked to his door and was sleeping soundly with the wine jar in his arms.

The old tables and chairs had a rotten smell.Dust was everywhere, and a few mice could be vaguely seen playing in the corner.But Lu Fan liked this place because it was quiet, without ridicule or sarcasm.

Lu Fan knocked on the counter, and Lao Wu opened his hazy sleepy eyes.

Looking up at Lu Fan, Old Wu reached out his hand first, and Lu Fan took out the copper plate and threw it on the counter.

Old Wu first put away the copper plate, and then actually handed the wine jar in his arms to Lu Fan, saying in a slightly muddy voice: "There's half left, I'm giving you an advantage. If you can't finish it, bring it back to me."

Old Wu smiled and took out a bowl with a chipped mouth and put it on the counter.

Lu Fan took away the wine jar and bowl, found a random table and sat down, filled a bowl of wine, and took a big gulp.

The strong wine entered his stomach from his throat, and soon Lu Fan felt his body heat up, as if there was a fire burning in his body.

Lu Fan sighed in admiration.The second reason why he likes this store is because the wine here is strong and different from other places.

Lao Wu smiled and said: "That's right, I don't care whose wine it is. Lu Fan, have you been hit again?"

Lu Fan smiled bitterly and said, "I will never be hit again."

Lao Wu said: "Don't say that. Don't you think it's a miracle that you can survive until now? I still remember the first time you walked into my store, you were as thin as a little monkey. You were almost dead. Look at you now, everything is normal."

Lu Fan laughed, Lao Wu was right.When he was a child, the doctor diagnosed him that he would never survive the age of twelve, but now that he has lived to be seventeen and is still well, it is indeed a miracle.

Lu Fan turned to Lao Wu and said, "That might be your wine."

A strange light flashed in Lao Wu's eyes, and he also smiled and said: "Of course, my wine is of course the best."

Lu Fan sighed and said: "My woman abandoned me because I am a waste."

Old Wu narrowed his eyes and said, "Then she will definitely regret it in the future."

Lu Fan chuckled and said, "Old Wu, thank you for comforting me."

Lao Wu smiled and said: "Believe me, this is not comfort."

Lu Fan poured himself another bowl of wine and said, "It's a pity, I'm afraid I won't be able to drink your wine again."

The smile on Lao Wu's face faded, and he walked over from behind the counter and said, "What's wrong? Are you leaving?"

Lu Fan nodded and said, "Yes, I'm leaving. I failed this year's martial arts academy test. I'm already seventeen years old, and at most I'll have the last chance for the test next year, but my family will never let me be embarrassed. They will release me after this year's annual festival. I don't know where I will be released, but I will definitely never come back."

Old Wu staggered and sat down opposite Lu Fan and said, "Is it so miserable?"

Lu Fan nodded and said: "Yes, it is so miserable. Old Wu, I will buy you a few more jars of wine when I leave to drink on the way."

Lao Wu said: "No problem. I will definitely prepare a few more jars for you. But I think you don't have to leave. You might as well try again next year. Maybe you can pass the exam?"

Lu Fan laughed, but his smile was slightly sad.

Lao Wu said: "Then you won't practice martial arts anymore?"

Lu Fan's eyes suddenly became sharp at this time, and he said: "I will definitely practice martial arts. Martial arts is everything to me. Even if I can't condense the strength in this life, I am proud to be a martial arts practitioner."

Old Wu's expression changed slightly, as if he didn't expect Lu Fan to say such passionate words at this time.

"Last night there was a cold wind and a waning moon, and today it is raining and snowing.When will the waves of the bitter sea rest? Drunk will relieve a thousand sorrows.Thinking about ten years of martial arts, tears flowed into the cup.Those who have the sky in their hearts go first, who knows and who stays."

Lu Fan listened to Lao Wu's poems with sadness in his eyes, raised the wine jar and started drinking.

Old Wu chanted the last two sentences softly, stood up, and walked back to the counter.

He slowly took out a small jar of wine from under the counter with his hand.

"Come on, Lu Fan, drink from my cup.I have been saving this jar of wine for twenty years. Let us get drunk today."

Kaifeng, the aroma fills the house.Lu Fan watched with drunken eyes as Old Wu poured him a bowl of wine, and said with a smile: "Why is this wine green?"

Lao Wu looked calm, no longer drunk at all, and said softly: "You drank too much."

Lu Fan smiled and said, "Yes, I drank too much.Let me taste the difference in your bowl of wine."

Lu Fan raised his head and poured a bowl of wine into his throat. Lu Fan felt as if a fire was going straight into his chest and abdomen starting from his throat.Lu Fan's entire face turned red.

Lao Wu poured another bowl for Lu Fan and said, "Keep drinking, this wine must be strong enough."

Lu Fan felt like he was almost speechless. After a while, he held back two words and said: "Enough."

After saying that, Lu Fan drank another bowl, and this time the feeling was even stronger.

Lu Fan seemed to be able to hear his bones making clicking sounds, his energy and blood were boiling, and his vision was starting to get a little blurry.

Standing up, Lu Fan said: "Old Wu, it seems that I am really drunk, no, I have to go back first."

Lu Fan staggered out, and Old Wu looked at Lu Fan's back and said, "Remember to come over for a drink in a few days, I'll keep this jar of wine for you."

Lu Fan waved his hand and said: "Don't worry, I will definitely come."

Lao Wu smiled and said softly: "Of course you will come."

Old Wu waved his hand gently, and saw the wine jar floating gently as if manipulated by a ghost, and then fell back to the counter.

Lao Wu tapped his fingers on the table regularly, shook his head and sang softly.

"Eight thousand miles of mountains and rivers, sword and wine, ninety thousand miles of sky, dreams and awakening.Three cups can lead to the great road, and one cup can bring heaven and earth together.Yin and yang are in the cup, and life is in the wine.I don’t know where I will go tomorrow, who will laugh at me, and who will I laugh at......"

On the way home, the north wind howled, and the flying snow hit Lu Fan's face like a knife, but he didn't notice it at all.

Walking back to Lu's house swaying, he could already see the door in the distance.

But at this time, the center of gravity under his feet was unstable, and Lu Fan fell to the ground.

Lying on the ground, Lu Fan felt like he had no energy left in his body, leaving only the heat flowing in his body.

His consciousness gradually became blurry. Lu Fan lay on the ground without getting up. Heavy snow slowly covered his body.

A ray of light shone from his body and disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.His body made a low groan, and the pores all over his body opened. Visible to the naked eye, a stream of air swirled around him.

If there were any martial arts masters who happened to be here, they would definitely scream in surprise, because Lu Fan's current situation is really like the rebirth in the martial arts legend.
